known_limitations: The primary M6-M14 estimand remains a total compiled-interface bundle effect; execution, structure and conclusion mechanisms are identified only through secondary contrasts.
Lossless common-envelope feasibility must be demonstrated against the smallest declared student context before dataset split construction.
Teacher modes are eligible for B* only if their complete artifacts fit the same lossless envelope; feasibility remains a pre-GATE-001 input.

The repository validate_causal_design.py is currently an artifact-level wrapper; deterministic YAML/cross-file checks were used, and the independent reviewer must decide whether a dedicated semantic validator is required.
Smallest meaningful gain and powered sample size remain WP-006 responsibilities.
unexpected_findings: The original token-matching rule weakened M14 through deterministic truncation and therefore mixed compilation with information loss; this path is now prohibited.
One global baseline is reproducible but can be convenient for some model profiles; mandatory profile-wise strongest-baseline sensitivity was added.
The original M6-M3 comparison remains diagnostic only and is prohibited as the headline causal result.
An unfavorable M11 result can remove the need for an LLM renderer without invalidating the value of trusted execution.
